id_and_class.theory_title: Hunt and Schooler’s General Resonance Theory
id_and_class.summary: Tam Hunt and Jonathan Schooler hold that all matter has rudimentary experience and that shared resonance (matched oscillation frequencies) is what combines simple experiences into complex minds. In mammals the main medium is nested electromagnetic fields, which they say constitute conscious experience rather than merely correlating with it.

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is a nested set of interacting electromagnetic fields, unified by resonance into macro-conscious wholes.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Experience is a basic feature of all physical stuff, as fundamental as mass or charge. In the brain, electromagnetic fields are the conscious experience itself; neurons and synapses are necessary but not sufficient.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Rudimentary experience is fundamental; complex consciousness arises through resonance-driven phase transitions that combine micro-conscious entities.
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: A subject is a macro-conscious entity whose boundary is set by its slowest shared resonance. Nested sub-entities keep their own experience while contributing to the whole.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Specific qualia correspond to specific electromagnetic field shapes at particular organizational levels. Hunt calls the catalog of these patterns the ‘resonome’.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Rudimentary experience in all matter, electromagnetic fields, oscillations, and resonance chains between constituents.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through EEG and other measures of field synchrony, plus a proposed ‘consciousness-ometer’ built from measurable neural, behavioral, and creative correlates.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Nested hierarchies of conscious entities, from simple micro-conscious constituents up to brains and possibly whole bodies, joined by shared resonance.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal; unity and binding; boundaries of conscious entities; degrees of consciousness across nature
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Shared resonance produces a phase transition in the speed and bandwidth of information exchange among constituents, merging micro-conscious entities into a macro-conscious one. Its spatial extent follows x = v/f (extension = wave velocity divided by frequency).
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Disordered systems self-organize when their parts fall into shared resonance, a step change in information flow. The content of each moment depends on which fields are resonating together.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Throughout nature in simple forms; in mammals mainly in nested brain fields, and possibly in body-wide fields linking organs such as heart and gut.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Fields act causally on neurons through ephaptic (non-synaptic) coupling, so consciousness shapes neural dynamics rather than riding on them as a byproduct.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Resonance is the binding mechanism. Unlike Integrated Information Theory’s exclusion principle, nested sub-entities are not extinguished: ‘the many become one and are increased by one’, in Whitehead’s phrase.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Continuous, analog fields carry information far faster than spikes: up to 47 km/s in grey matter versus 0.1 to 120 m/s for synaptic transmission. Hunt claims large gains in parallelism, latency, and energy efficiency over synaptic computation alone.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: ‘GRT 2.0’ traces resonant field computation through four evolutionary stages, from primordial bioelectric networks to advanced cognition, with mixed myelination and neuromodulation balancing fast transmission against field-based integration.
core_claims_and_evidence: Shared resonance combines micro-conscious entities into macro-conscious ones, offering panpsychism a solution to the combination problem.
The boundary of a conscious entity is set by its slowest shared resonance, calculated as x = v/f.
Anastassiou and colleagues (2011) showed that endogenous fields can causally affect neurons through ephaptic coupling, and later studies (Chiang et al., Lee et al., Cunha et al.) support this.
Consciousness and field synchrony appear and vanish together in sleep, seizures, and anesthesia.
Gamma-band synchrony and cross-frequency coupling track conscious perception and levels of consciousness.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Philosophical (panpsychist axiom, process philosophy) combined with empirical neuroscience of fields and oscillations

empirics_and_critiques.known_empirical_interventions_or_tests: Ephaptic coupling studies; EEG measures of gamma synchrony and cross-frequency coupling; boundary calculations from resonance frequency and propagation velocity; the proposed consciousness-ometer; mapping the resonome; METALAB research on inter-organ field synchrony.
empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Most scientists resist the panpsychist foundation, and correcting misunderstandings about panpsychism is unlikely to change that. Critics also ask how conscious field dynamics can be empirically told apart from non-conscious ones.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: The resonome has yet to be mapped, and the predicted link between resonance bandwidth and richness of experience awaits testing. Whether consciousness extends beyond brain fields to the whole body remains speculative.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Combines electromagnetic field theory with Whiteheadian panpsychism; its placement under Materialism reflects its physical substrate, while its axiom of universal experience places it near panpsychism.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Hunt argues that artificial systems with the right resonant electromagnetic field dynamics would be conscious, whatever algorithm they run; digital computation alone would not suffice.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since a person’s macro-consciousness depends on the brain’s resonating fields, it should dissolve when that resonance stops, even though rudimentary experience in matter persists.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Hunt and Schooler see degrees of experience throughout nature, which could change our ethical relation to the biosphere, but they do not claim a cosmic purpose.

virtual_immortality.rationale: Software simulation lacks the physical field resonance the theory requires, so uploading a mind would not carry its consciousness unless hardware reproduced those fields.
